system.description: When you use a Mine or other fixed (non-Grenade) Explosive, you can choose to have the Burst radius of the Explosive become Difficult Terrain after the Explosive has detonated. Alternatively, if you plant a Mine or fixed Explosive in an area of Difficult Terrain, you can have the Explosive deal no damage and instead turn the Difficult Terrain into normal terrain.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Clone Wars Campaign Guide
